mapper.select: SELECT t1.BALH_CO , t1.BALH_NM , t1.TR_STOP_GB , t1.SOSOK_GB , t1.AEKM , t1.GR_BALH_GB , TO_CHAR(t1.BUDO_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS budo_ymd , t1.COMP_CD , t1.GYUL_MM , t1.ISIN_CD , t1.COMP_BU , t1.BALH_NATION , t1.ENC_BUBIN_NO , NVL(t1.DEL_YN, '0') AS del_yn , TO_DECRYPTS(t1.enc_bubin_no) AS bubin_no , 1 AS p_visible FROM sjx0jb t1 WHERE NVL(t1.SOSOK_GB, '%') LIKE #{sosokGb} AND LENGTH(t1.balh_co) > #{cdLen} ORDER BY t1.del_yn ASC, t1.balh_co ASC

SELECT BALH_CO , TO_CHAR(YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ymd , CHG_COLUMN , BF_DATA , AF_DATA , NVL(SKT0BU, 'N') AS skt0bu , UPD_USER FROM sjx0jb_history WHERE balh_co = #{balhCo} ORDER BY chg_column ASC, ymd ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sjx0jb ( balh_co, balh_nm, tr_stop_gb, sosok_gb, aekm, gr_balh_gb, budo_ymd, comp_cd, gyul_mm, isin_cd, comp_bu, balh_nation, enc_bubin_no, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{balhCo}, #{balhNm}, #{trStopGb}, #{sosokGb}, #{aekm}, #{grBalhGb},
TO_DATE(#{budoYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL , #{compCd}, #{gyulMm}, #{isinCd}, #{compBu}, #{balhNation},
TO_ENCRYPTS(#{bubinNo}) NULL , NVL(#{delYn}, '0') )
mapper.update: UPDATE sjx0jb SET balh_nm = #{balhNm}, tr_stop_gb = #{trStopGb}, sosok_gb = #{sosokGb}, aekm = #{aekm}, gr_balh_gb = #{grBalhGb}, budo_ymd = TO_DATE(#{budoYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL , comp_cd = #{compCd}, gyul_mm = #{gyulMm}, isin_cd = #{isinCd}, comp_bu = #{compBu}, balh_nation = #{balhNation}, enc_bubin_no = TO_ENCRYPTS(#{bubinNo}) enc_bubin_no , del_yn = NVL(#{delYn}, '0') WHERE balh_co = #{balhCo}
